name: hermes64_pack_from_refs
description: Draft a Hermes64 THEME PACK (KITS 3.1.0 pack.json + lane-audio 1.1 audio.json) from 1-8 reference images plus structured reference notes. Measures palette/contrast/haze using Python and numpy (JPEG additionally needs Pillow), chooses existing kit presets, validates and builds with Python, and writes a lounge proof with existing Godot or an explicitly labelled lower-fidelity software preview. Blender is not required. Never copies reference pixels into distributable pack assets, calls a model or network, or marks a pack approved. Writes only <project_dir>/packs/<pack_id>/. This descriptor is staged for Main; not a registered Hermes tool in this lane.

reference_paths.description: PNG or JPEG files (<= 64 MiB each, <= 256 MiB total, <= 16384 px per side, <= 64 MP). Order matters: notes.references[].index refers to this list.

notes.description: reference_notes JSON (schema hermes64.reference_notes 1.0, refpack/schema/reference_notes.schema.json) as an object or a path to a JSON file (<= 256 KiB). Filled by the agent after viewing the images (see SKILL-refpack.md).

pack_id.description: New pack id. Shipped/core ids (polar_pod, forest_village, harbor_dusk, n64_v0, core, default) are refused.

project_dir.description: Existing project directory. Output goes to <realpath(project_dir)>/packs/<pack_id>/; an existing pack dir is reused only if it is a previous refpack draft.

read_root.description: Optional directory every reference must resolve inside (symlinks may not escape). Without it, a symlink may not leave its own folder.

render_proof.description: Build + render the lounge proof (validation always runs). Existing Godot is preferred; absent Godot uses a labelled lower-fidelity software preview, never visual approval.

ref_thumbnails.description: Put downscaled reference thumbnails on the private proof sheet.

mode.description: albedo = undo the baked light when deriving texture colours (default; better in the round-trip test); measured = use the measured colours as-is.

timeout_s.description: Proof stage timeout; the measure stage has its own 180 s bound.

ok.description: true only if every validator passed (status draft).

status.description: draft = valid, awaiting human review; invalid = drafted but a validator failed (files kept); rejected = bad input, nothing left behind. There is no approved status.

provenance.description: PROVENANCE.json: reference sha256s, notes hash, library/catalog hashes, output hashes, draft_unapproved.

validation_report.description: validation.json: lane-kits validate_pack_dict, registry resolution, room build + per-asset checks, audio palette check, refpack checks, style-match numbers.

proof_sheet.description: proof/proof_sheet.png: reference thumbnails | proof renders | palette, light ramp, fog.

hashes.description: sha256 of pack.json, audio.json and the measurements.
